thread:
Aisha (CSM): Heads up - BlueBay reported onboarding latency spikes during their import window. They want SLO evidence + proposed credit. Evelyn pinged in support.
Evelyn (BlueBay): Yep — our ETL saw lots of 5xx/timeouts. We captured client-side traces: several requests timed out at ~7s. Need timeline and credit calc for procurement.
Ben (Account Ops): Got it. Can SRE pull p50/p95/p99 for that window and uptime for the day? Contract lists monthly uptime SLO at 99.9% (monthly credit tiers). We need exact downtime minutes to compute credit.
Riley (SRE): I'll query now. Quick check shows a p95 spike ~3.2s between 10:06-10:09, p99 ~7.2s for two mins. Uptime metric for the day landed ~99.88% (so below 99.9). Running full time-bucketed query.
Riley (SRE): Query used:
```
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) AS minute, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95
FROM requests
WHERE org = 'bluebay' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-03-07 10:00:00' AND '2025-03-07 10:30:00'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute;
```
Riley (SRE): Results attached -> p95 surge 10:06..10:09 (~3.1-3.4s), p99 peak 10:06..10:08 (~6.8-7.4s). Impact window ~3m total. Full-day uptime 99.88% -> ~17.3m over monthly threshold.
Diego (Sales Eng): Contract credit tiers: 99.5-99.9% = 2% credit, <99.5% larger. Given 99.88% I'd propose 2% monthly credit. I'll attach calc sheet. Also note onboarding import is heavy tail — recommend warmup + dedicated pool option.
status-bot: Incident created INC-6123 and assigned to Riley. Alert: latency-regression (p95) @ 2025-03-07T10:06Z. :rotating_light:
Aisha (CSM): OK planning reply to BlueBay: timeline, trace bundle, p95/p99 graphs, and proposed 2% credit. Evelyn — anything else you need in the evidence bundle (e.g., raw spans, client logs, or signed statement)?
Evelyn (BlueBay): Raw spans + a short note on mitigation plan for procurement will be helpful. Also a one-page explainer on how credits are calculated so our finance team can sign off.
Ben (Account Ops): I'll draft the comms and the one-pager. Will cc legal for approve on the credit number before sending. Target EOD PST.
Riley (SRE): Adding remediation notes for the bundle: increased request batching timeout and adjusted KV cache warmup. Deploy to staging already scheduled. Span ids: span://traces/af3b2c -> will include link.
Diego (Sales Eng): As an upsell option, suggest offering a 30-day trial of Dedicated capacity at onboarding rates; include in comms as optional remediation to prevent recurrence.
Aisha (CSM): Good call. I'll include optional dedicated trial + runbook change (warmup before big imports). Evelyn — would that address your concerns enough to move forward?
Evelyn (BlueBay): Yes, that plus the credit looks fair. Please include the dedicated-trial terms in the email so procurement has options. Thanks for fast response. :pray:
Ben (Account Ops): No objections. Drafting now. Plan: send evidence + credit proposal + optional dedicated trial by EOD PST. If legal flags anything I will pause.
Riley (SRE): FYI tagging @eng-oncall for awareness and follow-up. I'll push the warmup config to prod canary tomorrow morning after verification.
status-bot: Deployment scheduled: warmup-config rollout -> staging @ 14:00 PST, canary prod 02:00 UTC next day.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks everyone — I'll coordinate the external comms and post final thread here after send. :thumbsup:
